q-0579.answer:
Surah Al-Ma'aarij (70) — The Ascending Stairways · 44 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The believers believe that its occurrence is near, even though its time of occurrence is unknown and no one knows when it will be except Allah.
• Man is described with blameworthy characteristics except for He whom Allah protects, helps and guides to good, making its means easy for him – and these are those people who perform Salah.
• What is wrong with these disbelievers who are with you, O Muhammad? Why are they Muhti'in, meaning hastily running away from you?' This is as Al-Hasan Al-Basri said, "Muhti'in means departing.
• Be patient, O Muhammad, with your people's rejection and their seeking to hasten the torment since they think it will not occur.
• Whenever any harm touches him he is frightful, worried and completely taken back due to the severity of his terror and his despair that he will receive any good after it.

Surah Al-Kawthar (108) — Abundance · 3 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Indeed he who hates you, O Muhammad, and he hates what you have come with of guidance, truth, clear proof and manifest light, he is the most cut off, meanest, lowliest person who will not be remembered.
• Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
• So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
• Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.

Surah Al-Kahf (18) — The Cave · 110 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• To those who oppose His Prophet ﷺ and disbelieve in His Book, He issues a warning of severe punishment hastened in this world and postponed to the world Hereafter.
• Their overwhelming punishment, destroying every last one of them.
• This thing that I did deliberately is one of the things I told you not to denounce me for, because you do not know the full story, and there is a reason and purpose for it that you do not know about.
• It has no basis apart from what they say, and they have no evidence for it apart from their own lies and fabrications.

q-5648.answer:
Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.
